name: 4-coumaroyl-CoA to adenin-9-yl riburonosate
summary: A 6-step route from 4-coumaroyl-CoA(4−) to adenin-9-yl riburonosate(1−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: 6'-deoxychalcone synthase
reactions.equation: 4-coumaroyl-CoA + 3 malonyl-CoA + NADPH + 4 H(+) = isoliquiritigenin + 3 CO2 + NADP(+) + 4 CoA + H2O

reactions.name: acridone synthase
reactions.equation: N-methylanthraniloyl-CoA + 3 malonyl-CoA + 3 H(+) = 1,3-dihydroxy-N-methylacridone + 3 CO2 + 4 CoA + H2O

reactions.name: tRNA-uridine aminocarboxypropyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(47) in tRNA(Phe) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3-[(3S)-3-amino-3-carboxypropyl]uridine(47) in tRNA(Phe) + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + H(+)
